title: Add object storage adapters

context.summary: Create the object storage interface, local filesystem adapter and S3/MinIO adapter skeleton.
context.background: TASK-5 established the API skeleton. TASK-6 adds the storage abstraction needed before document upload stores original files.

in: Define ObjectStorage interface and storage errors in @mindory/core.
Implement local-fs object storage adapter using the configured root directory.
Add S3/MinIO adapter skeleton with config shape and explicit not-implemented failures.
Wire package exports and workspace references for storage packages.
Add object storage validation to repository checks.
out: Add S3 SDK dependency or real S3 network calls.
Integrate storage adapters into API runtime.
Change Docker Compose app runtime placeholders.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/core exports ObjectStorage, storage metadata types and StorageError.
@mindory/storage-local-fs exports a local filesystem adapter that can put, read, stat, check and delete objects.
The local filesystem adapter prevents absolute keys and path traversal outside its root.
@mindory/storage-s3 exports S3/MinIO configuration and a skeleton adapter with explicit not-implemented behavior.
Storage packages depend on @mindory/core and expose their public modules.
Repository checks include object storage validation.
Documentation explains the storage abstraction, local-fs behavior and S3 skeleton status.
No document upload API, database persistence integration or real S3 network behavior is implemented.

manual_checks: Confirm local-fs storage rejects path traversal.
Confirm S3 adapter is clearly a skeleton and does not perform network calls.
Confirm no document upload API or database persistence integration was added.

risks: The S3/MinIO adapter is intentionally a skeleton until a later task adds the SDK dependency and integration tests.
Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
